# Phase 7 P7-T-005 fixture: 8-card 910B server (the most common 910B
# host topology). Two HCCS rings, each containing 4 NPUs:
#   ring 0 = NPU0, NPU1, NPU2, NPU3
#   ring 1 = NPU4, NPU5, NPU6, NPU7
# Sanitized of any real hostname / serial info.
#
# Sidecar comments parsed by parse.go (npu-smi -t topo doesn't actually
# emit numa/health inline; the parser tolerates these as test-only
# hints — real npu-smi output reaches NUMA + Health via -t board
# queries that ExecClient T101 wires).
# numa: NPU0=0 NPU1=0 NPU2=0 NPU3=0 NPU4=1 NPU5=1 NPU6=1 NPU7=1
# health: NPU0=Healthy NPU1=Healthy NPU2=Healthy NPU3=Healthy NPU4=Healthy NPU5=Healthy NPU6=Healthy NPU7=Healthy
       NPU0   NPU1   NPU2   NPU3   NPU4   NPU5   NPU6   NPU7
NPU0   X      HCCS   HCCS   HCCS   PIX    PIX    PIX    PIX
NPU1   HCCS   X      HCCS   HCCS   PIX    PIX    PIX    PIX
NPU2   HCCS   HCCS   X      HCCS   PIX    PIX    PIX    PIX
NPU3   HCCS   HCCS   HCCS   X      PIX    PIX    PIX    PIX
NPU4   PIX    PIX    PIX    PIX    X      HCCS   HCCS   HCCS
NPU5   PIX    PIX    PIX    PIX    HCCS   X      HCCS   HCCS
NPU6   PIX    PIX    PIX    PIX    HCCS   HCCS   X      HCCS
NPU7   PIX    PIX    PIX    PIX    HCCS   HCCS   HCCS   X
Legend:
  X    = self
  SYS  = Connection traversing PCIe and the SMP interconnect between NUMA nodes
  HCCS = Connection traversing at most a single HCCS switch
  PIX  = Connection traversing a single PCIe switch (PHB)
